grader_notes: The agent reached the correct PASS decision but failed to identify any of the specific, management-focused reasons Buffett provided in his retrospective account. The agent focused on generic macroeconomic and fundamental analysis rather than the firm-specific governance and management failures (Fuld's behavior, commitment of personal cash) that drove Buffett's actual refusal.
